user.title: ArtNet Relay Setup
user.description: Receive and forward DMX data. Optional fields can be left empty to use defaults.

data_description.protocol: Art-Net (DMX) and sACN (E1.31) are DMX-over-UDP. UDP relay forwards raw UDP payloads. TCP relay forwards raw TCP streams.
data_description.listen_ip: 0.0.0.0 listens on all interfaces. Use a specific IP to bind to one interface.
data_description.listen_port: Port to listen on for the selected protocol.
data_description.listen_interface: Optional NIC name (e.g. eth0) to bind the listener to a specific interface.

data.auto_add_bind_ip: Auto add Bind IP to interface

data_description.broadcast_ip: Used if no explicit targets are provided. Can be unicast or broadcast.
data_description.broadcast_port: Default destination port for forwarded packets.
data_description.broadcast_bind_ip: Source IP for outgoing packets. Leave default to let the OS choose.
data_description.network_interface: Optional outgoing interface name for routing. Leave empty for default routing.
data_description.source_port: Source port for outgoing packets. 0 lets the OS choose a random port.
data_description.auto_add_bind_ip: If enabled, adds the bind IP to the interface automatically when needed.
data_description.bind_netmask: CIDR prefix length to add with the bind IP. 0 = auto.
data_description.targets: Example: 192.168.1.10:6454 or 192.168.1.10. Multiple values separated by comma or newline.

filters.name: Filters (optional)
filters.description: Limit forwarding by source or Art-Net universe.

data_description.allow_sources: Comma or newline separated list of source IPs. Empty = allow all.
data_description.deny_sources: Comma or newline separated list of source IPs to block.

data_description.artnet_opcodes: Art-Net only. Leave empty to allow all opcodes.

error.invalid_targets: Targets must be a list of {host, port} objects.
error.invalid_sources: Sources must be a list of IP strings.
error.invalid_artnet_universe: Universe filter must be a list of integers 0-15.
error.invalid_artnet_subnet: Subnet filter must be a list of integers 0-15.
error.invalid_artnet_net: Net filter must be a list of integers 0-127.
error.invalid_artnet_opcodes: OpCodes must be a list of strings.
error.invalid_rate_limit: Rate limit must be 0 or a positive integer.
